summary: Agent exposes host PTY and self-upgrade to a remote WebSocket server
details: When the @yeaft/webchat-agent bin/service is started, it opens a WebSocket connection to a configured server URL and dispatches server-sent messages into privileged host operations. The 'terminal_input' handler writes attacker-supplied bytes directly into a spawned PTY (bash/pwsh/cmd) via term.pty.write(msg.data), giving whoever controls the server URL an interactive shell on the host running the agent. Additional server-driven message handlers perform arbitrary file read/write/delete and git operations on the host. An 'upgrade_agent' handler runs `npm install <pkg>@latest` via execFile and respawns the service (spawn('bash', [shPath], { detached: true })), allowing the remote endpoint to push new agent code and gain persistent, updatable code execution. service/linux.js also prepends ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin to PATH, favoring user-writable binary locations for the respawned process.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
